name: Пульт: свет только от экранов
about: Тесный технический отсек, единственный свет — от приборов: сине-зелёное свечение снизу на лицах и потолке, всё остальное тонет. Кабели, тумблеры, наклейки.
style_notes_en: painterly digital concept art with photographic weight, rendered as a film keyframe rather than a photograph or a classical painting; practical light sources visible or implied inside the frame; full value range down to true black; visible brush economy on metal and fabric while the focal object holds crisp detail; worn lived-in objects — mugs, taped paper, handwritten notes, scuffed panels — rendered with the same care as the machinery; desaturated palette split warm against cool; wide cinematic framing with foreground objects cropped by the frame edge; a cramped technical compartment lit only by its own instruments, blue-green screen glow rising onto faces and the ceiling from below, everything beyond the consoles sinking into black, cable looms, toggle switches and worn labels, cyan and amber indicator lights as the only saturation
